description: This file defines an internal struct 'PaddedLong' used for padding a long value to prevent false sharing by aligning it with CPU cache line size. It includes methods for volatile reading and atomic compare-and-swap operations.

classes.name: PaddedLong
classes.description: An internal struct that encapsulates a long value padded to align with CPU cache lines to mitigate false sharing.

methods.name: VolatileRead
methods.description: Reads the value of the 'Value' field with memory barriers if required.

methods.name: CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap operation on the 'Value' field.
